best_global.description: Koopman operator theory with deep autoencoder for linear dynamics in latent space
best_global.design_rationale: Koopman theory learns linear dynamics in a nonlinear latent space, enabling stable long-horizon forecasting via matrix powers. The autoencoder structure handles the nonlinear embedding.

principles: Koopman-based architectures with moderate latent dimensions (32) and explicit regularization outperform high-dimensional unregularized variants and complex hybrid models, suggesting that enforced linear dynamics structure in latent space is more effective than increased capacity for time series forecasting.
